events.head: Yatsen Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results

events.head: Yellow Wood Partners Agrees to Acquire Nestlé's Holistic Health Platform

events.head: Victoria Beckham Holdings Returns to Profit as Beauty Drives Group Growth
events.sum: Victoria Beckham Holdings reported its first operating profit since launching 18 years ago, with 2025 revenue up 15% to £129.8 million driven by the beauty division.

events.head: Skyline Beauty Group Acquires Lumin and Meridian From Pangaea Holdings
events.sum: Skyline Beauty Group acquired men's skincare brand Lumin and body-grooming brand Meridian, which together generated roughly $35M in trailing sales. Terms were undisclosed; it's Skyline's second acquisition in five months following LilyAna Naturals. Off-watchlist companies — market intelligence.

events.head: Shein Completes Hong Kong IPO as Listing Reshapes Investor Obligations
events.sum: Shein completed its Hong Kong IPO, raising roughly $1.7 billion at a valuation of about $26 billion — down sharply from its 2022 peak of $98.2 billion — a capital-markets event relevant to the K-beauty brands that reach shoppers through its cross-border marketplace.

events.head: Dollar Shave Club Acquires Truly Beauty in First-Ever Acquisition
events.sum: Dollar Shave Club, under CEO Larry Bodner, acquired Gen Z-focused body care brand Truly Beauty as it builds a multi-brand personal care platform. Financial terms were not disclosed; both brands will retain separate identities while integrating backend operations. Off-watchlist companies — market intelligence.

events.head: So-Young Reports Unaudited Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
events.sum: The China-based aesthetic treatment platform posted Q2 total revenue of RMB505.2 million (US$74.5M), up 33.4% year on year, driven by a 129.5% jump in aesthetic treatment services revenue.

events.head: Mao Geping Cosmetics Reports 26.2% Revenue Growth in First Half

events.head: Ulta Beauty Raises 2026 Guidance as Q2 Sales Reach US$3 Billion
events.sum: Ulta Beauty has raised its fiscal 2026 guidance after reporting an 8.9 percent increase in second-quarter net sales, supported by comparable sales growth, new stores and the acquisition of Space NK. events.head: LG H&H Expands Dr.Groot Across 424 Sephora Stores in the US
events.sum: LG Household & Health Care rolled out its Dr.Groot premium scalp-care brand into 424 Sephora US locations, following a March digital launch on Sephora.com and a ~90-store pilot in May.

events.head: Ulta Beauty Beats Wall Street Expectations, Raises Full-year Forecasts Amid Strong Q2 Performance
events.sum: Bolstered by an 8.9 percent sales increase, international expansion and new initiatives, the beauty retailer raised its outlook for continued growth.

events.head: Ulta Beauty beats Q2 estimates, raises full-year 2026 guidance
events.sum: Ulta reported Q2 FY2026 net sales up 8.9% to $3.0B and diluted EPS of $6.55 (vs. $6.17 est.), boosted by comp-sales growth and the Space NK acquisition; it raised FY2026 EPS guidance to $28.70-$29.00 and net sales growth guidance to 6.7%-7.2%.

events.head: KKR buys Japanese beauty platform Ci FLAVORS from L Catterton and founder
events.sum: KKR agreed to acquire Ci FLAVORS, a Japanese beauty and lifestyle brand platform spanning haircare, skincare and body care (including &honey and MOROCCAN BEAUTY), from L Catterton and other shareholders for an undisclosed amount. Founder Yusaku Horiuchi and CEO Yoshiaki Okura will reinvest alongside KKR.

events.head: Regent to acquire Avon North America from LG H&H, reuniting Avon under common ownership
events.sum: Regent affiliate Stratford Worldwide agreed to buy LG H&H's stake in The Avon Company, reunifying Avon North America with Avon's international operations (which Regent already owns after its January 2026 purchase from Natura &Co) for the first time since 2016. Financial terms were not disclosed; the deal is expected to close September 1. LG H&H had bought the business for $125M in 2019.

events.head: KIKO Milano enters Uruguay with an €8.55M expansion plan
events.sum: KIKO Milano will open its first Uruguay store at Montevideo Shopping in late October in partnership with Grupo Antelo, investing €8.55M to build an eight-store network over five years and create around 100 jobs. Strong performance could open the door to a subsequent expansion into Argentina.

events.head: Adore Beauty posts record FY26 revenue as store network triples but EBITDA falls
events.sum: The Australian beauty retailer reported record FY2026 revenue of A$207.3M (+4.3%), helped by an $18.6M contribution from its store network which grew from 7 to 20 locations, but underlying EBITDA fell 39% to A$3.8M on investment costs. It is targeting at least 10% revenue growth in FY27.

events.head: Wipro Consumer Care buys 60% of Dermatouch for ₹3.88B to enter digital-first premium skincare
events.sum: Wipro Consumer Care and Lighting agreed to acquire a 60% stake in Indian skincare brand Dermatouch at an enterprise value of ₹3.88B (about US$44M), its entry into India's digital-first premium skincare segment. Dermatouch gains Wipro's distribution reach and R&D.

events.head: Target lifts full-year outlook as Q2 sales rise 5.3% and beauty grows high single digits
events.sum: Q2 net sales rose 5.3% to US$26.5B with comparable sales up 3.8% and digital comps up 8.7%. Beauty delivered high single-digit growth and Target raised full-year net sales guidance to roughly 5%, a point above prior expectations — read closely by Ulta, whose shop-in-shop agreement with Target concludes this month.

events.head: Essity to acquire Kenvue's Brazil feminine care business for $284M
events.sum: Essity agreed to buy Kenvue's Brazilian feminine care business — the Carefree, Sempre Livre and o.b. brands — for $284M on a cash- and debt-free basis, expanding its Latin America feminine care platform. The unit generated ~BRL 800M in trailing net sales; closing is expected Q2 2027, contingent on the Kimberly-Clark/Kenvue transaction completing.

events.head: PROYA partners with Ulta Beauty to enter US prestige skincare
events.sum: Chinese skincare brand PROYA will join Ulta Beauty's prestige portfolio, launching its Advanced Firming and Original Repair collections in 400 stores nationwide and online this November. No financial terms were disclosed.

events.head: Estée Lauder returns to growth as FY2026 sales rise 5% and margins expand
events.sum: Full-year net sales reached $15.05B with 3% organic growth, marking a return to growth after a difficult stretch; Q4 organic sales rose 5% and operating margin expanded 320bps for the year. Shares jumped on a bullish FY2027 outlook.

events.head: Coty beats Q4 revenue expectations but losses widen, and names Soraya Benchikh CFO
events.sum: Q4 sales for the year ended 30 June rose 1% with like-for-like improving sequentially to -1%, despite an estimated 1% drag from the Middle East conflict. Sales, profit and cash flow came in ahead of expectations on cost control, but the quarterly loss widened and guidance is for a low-to-mid single-digit revenue decline. Former British American Tobacco finance chief Soraya Benchikh becomes CFO.

events.head: CVC Capital invests KRW300B in K-beauty distributor Silicon2
events.sum: CVC Asia will acquire a 9.23% stake in Korean K-beauty distribution platform Silicon2 via newly issued convertible shares, valuing the company at an enterprise value of roughly $2.1B. Proceeds will fund international distribution and logistics expansion.

events.head: River Associates acquires personal care manufacturer Diamond Wipes
events.sum: The Chattanooga private equity firm acquired Diamond Wipes, a North American contract manufacturer of disposable wet wipes and liquid-fill personal care products, from Nolan Capital. The transaction closed on 7 August and was funded from River VIII; add-on acquisitions are planned. Terms undisclosed.

events.head: Amorepacific takes Mamonde into India in an exclusive Nykaa partnership
events.sum: Mamonde debuted in India exclusively on Nykaa, the country's largest beauty platform, with ten products built around its Rose HA and Peony BHA lines and Hyper-Flora technology. The launch extends Amorepacific's K-beauty push beyond its Americas and EMEA momentum into a fast-growing market.

events.head: Douglas Q3 sales slip 2% and adjusted EBITDA falls 19.4% as it reviews its store network
events.sum: Group sales fell 2.0% to €987.8M with like-for-like down 4.5% and adjusted EBITDA down 19.4% to €127.5M, on weak premium demand in Germany, France and the Netherlands. Guidance for FY25/26 was held at €4.58–4.63B revenue and a 15% adjusted EBITDA margin; exclusive brands grew double digits.

events.head: Sephora partners with Glam42 to bring Sephora Collection to Israel
events.sum: A distribution partnership putting the Sephora Collection own-brand range into the Israeli market through local operator Glam42, extending the retailer's Middle East footprint.

events.head: Haleon prices a $2B three-tranche bond to refinance 2027 maturities
events.sum: Haleon Capital priced $600M of 4.625% notes due 2029, $600M of 4.875% due 2031 and $800M of 5.375% due 2036, settling 21 August. Proceeds repurchase the 2027 notes tendered on 11 August and fund general corporate purposes.

events.head: Natura &Co profit plunges 92% in Q2 as Brazil pressure deepens
events.sum: Net income from continuing operations fell 92% year-on-year to R$35M (from R$446M) on a 9.1% consolidated revenue decline to R$5.17B, badly missing consensus. Brazil revenue dropped 14.8% to R$3.07B with the Natura brand down 14.5% and Avon down 22.5%, while Hispanic markets grew on a constant-currency basis.

events.head: Kenvue's beauty sales rise 5.1% as Neutrogena and OGX drive Q2 growth
events.sum: Kenvue's Skin Health and Beauty division posted 5.1% organic sales growth in Q2 2026, with 3.7% underlying organic growth split between 2.7 points of favourable value realisation and 1 point of volume. Neutrogena extended household-penetration gains for a third straight quarter in the US, with Hair Care and Face Care leading regional performance.

events.head: Ashland explores sale after takeover interest from PE firms
events.sum: Specialty ingredients supplier Ashland, valued around $3.5B, has engaged Citigroup and Lazard to explore a potential sale after inbound interest from Advent, Apollo and Carlyle, plus major shareholder Standard Industries. The process follows pressure from activist investor Ancora Holdings; a transaction is not certain.

events.head: APR's Q2 cosmetics revenue surges 185% on North America and Europe expansion
events.sum: South Korean beauty group APR (Medicube) posted Q2 revenue of KRW767.5B, up 134.2% year-on-year, with operating profit up 134.5% to KRW190.6B at a 24.8% margin. Cosmetics revenue jumped 185.5% to KRW648.3B, with North America up 264.6% and Europe up 380.3%; overseas sales now account for 92% of the total.

events.head: Fragrance brand Vyrao nears sale to undisclosed buyer
events.sum: British fragrance and wellness brand Vyrao, backed by Estée Lauder's New Incubation Ventures and L Catterton, is reportedly close to being acquired by an undisclosed buyer after five years of independent growth across the UK, US, Australia and Japan. Deal value and buyer identity remain unconfirmed.

events.head: PZ Cussons FY26 profit climbs as St.Tropez returns to North American growth
events.sum: PZ Cussons reported FY26 revenue of £541.4M, up 5.4% (5.8% like-for-like), with adjusted operating profit up 8.4% to £59.5M — up 24.5% excluding the divested PZ Wilmar joint venture. Self-tanning brand St.Tropez returned to growth in its key North American market, and each of the group's top ten brands grew during the year.

events.head: Haleon launches a tender offer for $1.999B of 2027 notes
events.sum: A cash tender for the outstanding 3.375% fixed-rate senior notes due March 2027, opening a refinancing of the group's near-term maturities.

events.head: Edgewell returns to organic growth as Q3 earnings beat expectations
events.sum: Edgewell Personal Care posted Q3 net sales of $570.1M, up 1.7%, with organic sales growth of 1.1% and adjusted EPS of $0.72 beating guidance. North America organic sales rose 3% on higher Sun Care, Skin Care and Grooming volumes, while international organic sales fell 1.4%.

events.head: Cymbiotika adds Alix Earle as investor in liposomal supplement brand
events.sum: Influencer Alix Earle has taken an undisclosed investment stake in Cymbiotika, joining a celebrity roster including Kendall Jenner, Hailey Bieber and The Weeknd. The bioactive supplement brand generated $150M in revenue last year and previously closed a $25M seed round in January 2026.

events.head: AKT London launches 'Final Encore' community crowdfunding round
events.sum: UK natural-deodorant brand AKT London opened a new community investment round, billed as its last raise of this kind, to let customers invest ahead of its next growth phase. Over 1,000 people pre-registered within 24 hours; the funding target was not disclosed.

events.head: Eurazeo to invest €410M in Aroma-Zone, taking control of French natural-beauty DTC
events.sum: Private equity firm Eurazeo has signed an exclusivity agreement to invest roughly €410M in Aroma-Zone, becoming the French natural beauty and aromatherapy retailer's main shareholder while the founding Vausselin family keeps a significant stake. Proceeds fund international expansion, the French e-commerce platform, and new stores beyond its current seven-store footprint.

events.head: Kenvue reports second-quarter 2026 results
events.sum: Second-quarter results released before market open, with the Skin Health and Beauty division's organic growth the key datapoint ahead of the Kimberly-Clark close.

events.head: e.l.f. Beauty raises FY2027 outlook as Q1 net sales jump 36%
events.sum: Q1 fiscal 2027 net sales rose 36% to $479.4M against roughly $431M consensus, with adjusted net income of $104.6M (from $51.3M) and adjusted EPS of $1.75 versus $0.71 expected. Management lifted full-year FY27 guidance to 18-20% net sales growth from 12-14%, and to $1.93-1.96B in sales from $1.83-1.86B.

events.head: Shiseido H1 operating profit climbs 132% as restructuring takes hold
events.sum: First-half net sales rose 6.2% to ¥499.0B with core operating profit up 90.1% to ¥44.4B and operating profit up 131.8% to ¥41.9B. China and Travel Retail sales rose 10.0% reported to ¥191.4B, with Clé de Peau Beauté and NARS driving the 618 festival.

events.head: Beiersdorf guides to a full-year sales decline as Nivea drops 6.8%
events.sum: CEO Vincent Warnery said the group needs to acquire brands to dilute its reliance on Nivea after the flagship fell 6.8% in H1 2026. Beiersdorf now expects organic sales to decline in the low single digits for the full year.

events.head: LG H&H discontinues colour brand TIPSY as portfolio narrows to ten priorities
events.sum: LG Household & Health Care is winding down TIPSY, the colour cosmetics brand acquired via its 2020 majority stake in Roa Korea, after it failed to regain traction against social-first indie rivals. Investment shifts to ten priority brands including The History of Whoo, CNP, Belif and Dr. Groot under CEO Lee Sunjoo's restructuring. Terms undisclosed.

events.head: Bodycare secures Arāya Ventures-led investment for AI-powered retail rollout
events.sum: UK health-and-beauty retailer Bodycare raised an undisclosed round led by Arāya Ventures, joined by entrepreneur Dilesh Mehta and a syndicate of retail, technology and consumer-brand investors. Proceeds fund its AIMEE AI platform, new Studio Stores in Derby and Leicester, and creator-led commerce.

events.head: P&G to acquire supplements maker Thorne for $3.8B in premium wellness push
events.sum: P&G is buying Thorne in an all-cash $3.8B deal from LVMH-backed L Catterton, its largest step yet into premium wellness and personal health alongside Metamucil, Align and New Chapter. Thorne passed $500M revenue in 2025 and tracks toward roughly $650M this year, skewing under-40 and direct-to-consumer; the exit marks a more than $3B return for L Catterton, which took it private at $680M in 2023.

events.head: LG H&H Q2 operating profit up 87.5% as North America overtakes China
events.sum: Q2 consolidated revenue rose 3.3% to KRW1.6574tn with operating profit up 87.5% to KRW102.8B. North American revenue surged 47.3% to KRW205.8B, passing China's KRW176B for the first time, while overseas revenue grew 12.6% to KRW584.5B. The Beauty division returned to profit on 3.9% revenue growth.

events.head: Oriflame Q2 sales fall 13% as transformation programme grinds on
events.sum: Q2 sales dropped 13% in both euros and local currencies, with adjusted EBITDA swinging to a €4.7M loss on lower volumes, inventory provisions and excess-stock liquidation. Latin America grew 6% while Europe & CIS, Turkey & Africa and Asia all declined; adjusted cash flow before financing stayed positive at €8.6M.

events.head: Boots £7B takeover talks stall after Weston family lowers its offer
events.sum: Sycamore Partners rejected a reduced bid from the Weston family's Wittington Investments for Boots, leaving the roughly £7B ($9.4B) sale in doubt with a source close to talks putting revival at 50/50. The Westons cut their offer after Sigma Healthcare's June exit left them sole bidder; Sycamore is expected to restart IPO plans next year if no deal lands.

events.head: Beiersdorf cuts FY2026 guidance and resolves an 18-month NIVEA turnaround
events.sum: H1 group sales fell 3.5% organically to €5.0B with NIVEA down 6.8% on customer conflicts, delayed seasonal demand and trade destocking, while derma brands Eucerin and Aquaphor grew 7.8%. The board resolved an 18-month NIVEA turnaround with an additional €100M of consumer-facing marketing in H2 and now guides to a low-single-digit organic sales decline for the year.

events.head: L'Oréal H1 growth accelerates to 6.5% with a record 21.3% operating margin

events.head: Amorepacific Q2 operating profit surges 53% as overseas revenue jumps 28%
events.sum: Group revenue of KRW1.2543tn with operating profit up 53% to KRW122.8B. At the flagship Amorepacific unit overseas revenue rose 28% and overseas operating profit nearly doubled, up 99%, led by the Americas and EMEA.

events.head: Amorepacific Group Q2 operating profit jumps 53.3% on Americas and EMEA strength
events.sum: Group Q2 revenue rose 14.6% to KRW1.25tn with operating profit up 53.3% to KRW122.8B, beating consensus. Americas and EMEA revenue climbed 28% with operating profit up 99%, while Greater China declined on channel optimisation. The group held a double-digit operating margin for a second consecutive quarter.

events.head: P&G Beauty net sales rise 7% to $16.0B in fiscal 2026
events.sum: Fourth-quarter and full-year results: the Beauty division was among the group's strongest, with annual net sales up 7% to $16.0B on hair care and premium skincare including SK-II. Beauty organic sales rose 4% in Q4 after 7% in Q3.

events.head: Unilever posts its best first half in a decade, Beauty & Wellbeing up 5.9%
events.sum: Group underlying sales grew 4.8% with volume contributing 4.2 points — the strongest volume-led first half in ten years. Beauty & Wellbeing rose 5.9% (4.5% volume), led by double-digit volume growth at Dove, Sunsilk and Vaseline plus prestige beauty.

events.head: LVMH Perfumes & Cosmetics holds flat at €3.9B as second-quarter growth accelerates
events.sum: Half-year revenue of €38.6B with organic growth of 2%, accelerating to 3% in Q2. Perfumes & Cosmetics was stable organically at €3.9B with a slightly higher operating margin, helped by Dior's J'adore Intense and Dior Addict launches, Guerlain and Maison Francis Kurkdjian.

events.head: Amorepacific to sell regional offices and logistics centres to fund overseas push
events.sum: Amorepacific is divesting domestic property — regional offices in Busan, Daegu, Daejeon and Gwangju plus logistics centres in Incheon and Gimhae — targeting roughly KRW150B (~$109M) to redirect capital toward its goal of 70% overseas revenue and KRW15tn sales by 2035. A group-level asset-efficiency programme, not a brand sale.

events.head: Amorepacific to sell Anseong inner-beauty plant, consolidate output at Osan
events.sum: Amorepacific is seeking a buyer for its Anseong health-supplement plant (KRW204.7B annual capacity, ~46% utilisation last year), which makes its Vital Beauty inner-beauty line, shifting production to its larger Osan complex to lift capital efficiency. Sale price undisclosed.

events.head: LG H&H launches auction for beverage unit Haitai HTB as K-beauty majors refocus
events.sum: LG H&H is running preliminary auctions for Haitai HTB, Korea's third-largest beverage company (~KRW343B annual sales), to concentrate on cosmetics as indie K-beauty brands gain share — paralleling Amorepacific's own asset disposals. Price undisclosed; intent letters expected this month.

events.head: First US-listed K-beauty ETF filed with the SEC
events.sum: US asset manager Guinness Atkinson filed a preliminary prospectus for the K-Beauty ETF (KBTY), set for NYSE Arca in H2 — at least 80% in South Korean beauty names spanning brand owners, contract manufacturers, ingredient suppliers, retailers and dermatology. A first dedicated public-markets vehicle for the sector.

events.head: Avon signs lease at The Rowe for a consolidated London headquarters

events.head: Frasers Group forces its way into the Harvey Nichols sale process

events.head: Prenetics' IM8 secures $1B growth financing from General Catalyst

events.head: Shein secures CSRC approval for a Hong Kong IPO

events.head: US appeals court revives Tylenol autism suits, clouding the $48.7B Kimberly-Clark deal

events.head: Rituals commits €40M to refresh 1,500 boutiques across 30 countries

events.head: Style Capital takes a minority stake in Essential Parfums

events.head: L'Oréal secures a 50-year exclusive worldwide beauty licence for Gucci

events.head: Coty agrees to hand the Gucci Beauty licence back to Kering for about $400M

events.head: Henkel closes its acquisition of Olaplex
events.sum: The $1.4B purchase of the prestige hair care brand completed, bringing Olaplex into Henkel's Consumer Brands hair portfolio alongside Schwarzkopf.

events.head: L'Oréal takes a majority stake in Indian personal care house Innovist

events.head: Ulta Beauty Q1 net sales rise 11.1% to $3.2B as comps gain 5.3%

events.head: Church & Dwight acquires stain-removal brand Miss Mouth's Messy Eater for about $325M

events.head: Estée Lauder and Puig terminate combination discussions
events.sum: The parties ended talks over a potential business combination, closing the door on what would have been a roughly $40B luxury beauty group and leaving Estée Lauder to pursue its turnaround independently.

events.head: Estée Lauder plans to divest Too Faced, Smashbox and Dr.Jart+

events.head: Shiseido Q1 2026 core operating profit jumps 58% despite a China slowdown

events.head: Kenvue reports first-quarter 2026 results

events.head: Coty reports third-quarter fiscal 2026 results

events.head: Estée Lauder lifts annual profit forecast while cutting up to 3,000 more jobs

events.head: Unilever Q1 2026 underlying sales up 3.8%, Beauty & Wellbeing up 3.6%

events.head: Amorepacific Group posts Q1 2026 revenue of KRW1.227tn

events.head: L'Oréal Q1 2026 sales rise 7.6% like-for-like to €12.15B

events.head: Clorox completes the GOJO acquisition, forming Clorox Purell

events.head: Henkel to acquire Olaplex for $1.4B in a pivot to premium hair care

events.head: Estée Lauder confirms merger discussions with Puig

events.head: Ulta Beauty posts Q4 and fiscal 2025 results, guides to 6–7% growth in fiscal 2026

events.head: Kenvue reports fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 results

events.head: Estée Lauder reports fiscal 2026 second-quarter results

events.head: Coty reports second-quarter fiscal 2026 results

events.head: Clorox to acquire Purell maker GOJO Industries for $2.25B

events.head: L'Oréal doubles Galderma stake to 20% to deepen its aesthetics play

Terms undisclosed; closing expected in Q1 2026, with two L'Oréal board candidates replacing consortium representatives at the 2026 AGM.

events.head: Kimberly-Clark to acquire Kenvue for $48.7B, creating a $32B health and wellness leader
events.sum: Cash-and-stock deal valuing Kenvue at $21.01 per share — $3.50 cash plus 0.14625 KMB shares, a roughly 46% premium. The combined group targets about $32B of annual revenue and $7B adjusted EBITDA, with roughly $1.9B of cost synergies over three years and Neutrogena and Aveeno joining the portfolio.

events.head: L'Oréal to buy Kering Beauté including Creed in €4B beauty and wellness alliance
